sponsored.t: Relates to the collection and use of foreign fire insurance premium taxes
sponsored.sum: Updates provisions regarding the collection and use of foreign fire insurance premium taxes by the Centerport Volunteer Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the town of Smithtown assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from Tiegerman Community Services, Inc.
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Smithtown assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from Tiegerman Community Services, Inc. for the 2023-2024 assessment rolls.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the town of Huntington to alienate and discontinue the use of certain parklands to the Huntington African American Museum
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Huntington to alienate and discontinue the use of certain parklands to the Huntington African American Museum.

sponsored.t: Establishes interschool robotics competitions for certain schools
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of education to promulgate and review as necessary rules and regulations allowing trustees and boards of education of schools with a robotics program to conduct interschool robotics competitions for grades nine through twelve equivalent to the interschool athletic competitions conducted by such schools.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the formation of a subsidiary of a public authority without prior approval of the legislature
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the formation of a subsidiary of a public authority without prior approval of the legislature; allows the formation of a subsidiary of a public authority without prior approval of the legislature if such public authority files a written notice sixty days prior to the organization of such subsidiary with the governor and the legislature.

sponsored.t: Establishes a town of Huntington deer management pilot program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a town of Huntington deer management pilot program.

sponsored.t: Requires towers to clean up any debris in the surrounding area resulting from the vehicles they are towing
sponsored.sum: Requires towers to clean up any debris in the surrounding area resulting from the vehicles they are towing and tow trucks to be equipped with the appropriate equipment for such clean up efforts.

sponsored.t: Relates to the Nesconset Volunteer Firefighter's Benevolent Association
sponsored.sum: Relates to the Nesconset Volunteer Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association; provides for the purpose of such association, and its use of foreign fire insurance premium taxes.

sponsored.t: Permits accidental death benefits and/or special accidental death benefits to be awarded to the beneficiary of Patricia Espinosa
sponsored.sum: Permits accidental death benefits and/or special accidental death benefits to be awarded to the beneficiary of Patricia Espinosa.
sponsored.fis: There will be an immediate past service cost of $3.20 million borne by the state of New York as a one-time payment. This cost assumes that payment will be made on March 1, 2027. This bill will not increase the state of New York's annual contributions.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the public service commission authority to order collection of charges from ratepayers for greenhouse gas reduction unrelated to the electric grid
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the public service commission authority to order collection of charges from ratepayers for greenhouse gas reduction unrelated to the electric grid.

sponsored.t: Prohibits a gas corporation, electric corporation or municipality from charging more than three percent on an annual utility bill
sponsored.sum: Prohibits a gas corporation, electric corporation or municipality from charging more than three percent on an annual utility bill absent a showing that the charge is necessary to maintain the reliability and safety of the grid.

sponsored.t: Relates to World Trade Center related accidental death benefit for Luis Palermo
sponsored.sum: Permits the widow of Luis Palermo to apply for a World Trade Center related accidental death benefit for participation in the rescue, recovery, and clean-up operations as a member of the Nassau county police department.
sponsored.fis: Refer to fiscal note in section 3.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of labor to conduct a study on the effects of artificial intelligence on job losses in the state
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of labor to conduct a study and prepare a report on the effects of artificial intelligence on job losses in the state.

sponsored.t: Enacts the New York Farm Distillery RTD Excise Tax Bill
sponsored.sum: Enacts the New York Farm Distillery RTD Excise Tax Bill establishing a beer-equivalent excise tax rate for certain low-alcohol ready-to-drink spirits products manufactured by eligible New York farm distilleries and small craft distilleries; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Relates to annual vehicular access for active volunteer firefighters and active volunteer ambulance workers
sponsored.ls: Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation Law
sponsored.sum: Provides annual vehicular access for New York state's active volunteer firefighters and active volunteer ambulance workers and their immediate family at any state park or recreational facility.

sponsored.t: Establishes a persistent domestic violence offender registry
sponsored.sum: Establishes a persistent domestic violence offender registry of individuals convicted of multiple domestic violence offenses, which is available for public inquiry.

sponsored.t: Designates all fire marshals in the county of Suffolk as peace officers; repealer
sponsored.sum: Designates all chief fire marshals, assistant chief fire marshals, fire marshal IIs and fire marshal Is employed by the county of Suffolk or a town or village therein as peace officers.

sponsored.t: Directs the New York state energy research and development authority to conduct a feasibility study on geothermal energy
sponsored.sum: Directs the New York state energy research and development authority to conduct a feasibility study and prepare a report on the benefits and implementation of geothermal energy.

sponsored.t: Relates to directing the public service commission to evaluate hydrogen, sewage thermal energy, and nuclear small modular reactors as renewable energy sources
sponsored.sum: Directs the public service commission to evaluate hydrogen, sewage thermal energy, and nuclear small modular reactors as renewable energy sources and report the results of such evaluation to the governor and the legislature.

sponsored.t: Directs the New York state energy research and development authority to conduct a feasibility study on the use of small modular reactors
sponsored.sum: Directs the New York state energy research and development authority to conduct a feasibility study and prepare a report on the benefits and implementation of nuclear small modular reactors.

sponsored.t: Directs the New York state energy research and development authority to conduct a feasibility study on carbon recapture
sponsored.sum: Directs the New York state energy research and development authority to conduct a feasibility study and prepare a report on the benefits and implementation of carbon recapture.

sponsored.t: Directs the New York state energy research and development authority to conduct a feasibility study on sewage thermal energy
sponsored.sum: Directs the New York state energy research and development authority to conduct a feasibility study and prepare a report on the benefits and implementation of sewage thermal energy.

sponsored.t: Establishes the hydrogen vehicle task force
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the New York state energy research and development authority in cooperation with the department of transportation to establish the New York state hydrogen vehicle task force to provide the governor and the legislature with information on the potential effects of expanding the fleet of hydrogen fuel cell vehicles in the state.

sponsored.t: Provides for an exclusion for treble damages in actions for forcible or unlawful entry or detainer
sponsored.ls: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law
sponsored.sum: Provides for an exclusion for treble damages in actions for forcible or unlawful entry or detainer where such treble damages are unavailable to a person who, not having entered a lease or license for such real property with the rightful owner, enters onto real property or otherwise settles on land or occupies real property without title, right, permission of the rightful owner, or payment of rent accepted by the rightful owner.

sponsored.t: Repeals the prohibition on fossil fuel equipment and building systems in new buildings; repealer
sponsored.sum: Repeals the prohibition on fossil fuel equipment and building systems in new buildings that is to become effective in 2026.

sponsored.t: Provides for a limited alternative remedy to remove unauthorized persons from residential real property
sponsored.ls: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law
sponsored.sum: Provides for a limited alternative remedy to remove unauthorized persons from residential real property if certain conditions are met.

sponsored.t: Excludes certain persons from the definition of occupant for the purposes of unlawful eviction
sponsored.ls: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law
sponsored.sum: Excludes persons who, not having entered a lease or license for such dwelling with the rightful owner, enters into a dwelling unit, onto real property or otherwise settles on land or occupies real property without title, right, permission of the rightful owner, or payment of rent accepted by the rightful owner from the definition of "occupant" for the purposes of unlawful eviction.

sponsored.t: Establishes the climate leadership and community protection act cost task force
sponsored.sum: Establishes the climate leadership and community protection act cost task force to study the impact on taxpayers and ratepayers of the implementation of the mandates set forth by the climate leadership and community protection act.

sponsored.t: Relates to criminal trespass in the third degree
sponsored.sum: Adds to the definition of trespassing in the third degree, not having entered a lease or license for such building or real property with the rightful owner, enters or remains in such building or upon such real property or otherwise occupies such building or real property without title, right, permission of the rightful owner, or payment of rent accepted by the rightful owner.

sponsored.t: Relates to rainwater harvesting
sponsored.sum: Provides for requirements for rainwater harvesting designed to temporarily store stormwater runoff for detention or re-use through retention; may assist in meeting stormwater runoff reduction goals.

sponsored.t: Relates to the receipt of compensation for advising or assisting with veterans' benefits matters
sponsored.sum: Establishes certain protections related to the receipt of compensation for advising or assisting with veterans' benefits matters, including penalties for violations.

sponsored.t: Relates to transition of control of certain homeowners' associations
sponsored.sum: Enacts provisions governing the transition of control of certain homeowners' associations; requires owner election of board members upon the occurrence of certain events, including the conveyance of title to 90% of the parcels in the community.

sponsored.t: Enacts the credit for rural energy infrastructure act of 2025
sponsored.sum: Enacts the credit for rural energy infrastructure act of 2025, to provide tax credits for certain activities expanding energy infrastructure into unserved rural areas.

sponsored.t: Enacts Paige's law
sponsored.sum: Enacts Paige's law to provide education and awareness regarding brain arteriovenous malformation and brain aneurysms, as well as information on being a potential carrier of hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia, thoracic aortic aneurysms, Marfan syndrome and related disorders and genetic testing for such conditions and disorders.

sponsored.t: Establishes the task force on battery storage facility fire safety
sponsored.sum: Establishes the task force on battery storage facility fire safety to collaborate with local governments, firefighters, and industry experts to develop new safety standards and best practices to protect neighborhoods, forests, and agricultural land in the state from dangerous battery storage facility fires.

sponsored.t: Provides for funding for the consolidated local street and highway improvement program
sponsored.sum: Provides for funding for the consolidated local street and highway improvement program from a percentage of online sales taxes.

sponsored.t: Creates a veteran's home and land ownership loan program
sponsored.sum: Creates a veteran's home and land ownership loan program to provide loans to veterans to purchase homes or unimproved land suitable for building; requires such loans to be secured by a second mortgage.

sponsored.t: Requires the dormitory authority of the state of New York to fulfill certain monetary commitments
sponsored.sum: Requires the dormitory authority of the state of New York to fulfill all outstanding monetary commitments made to any local government for a fiscal year prior to allocating any moneys to economic development grant programs for the following fiscal year.

sponsored.t: Allows individuals to request a notation on their driver's license indicating that they have autism spectrum disorder, or any other medical, mental, or behavioral condition that may alter or impair their behavio
sponsored.sum: Allows individuals to request a notation on their driver's license indicating that they have autism spectrum disorder, or any other medical, mental, or behavioral condition that may alter or impair their behavior; requires medical documentation to be submitted as proof upon such a request; directs the commissioner of motor vehicles to consult with the commissioner of health and the commissioner of mental health to determine a list of such conditions and disorders that may be indicated on an individual's driver's license.

sponsored.t: Requires that driver's licenses indicate the blood type of the licensee upon the licensee's request
sponsored.sum: Requires that driver's licenses indicate the blood type of the licensee upon the licensee's request.

sponsored.t: Disallows the suspension or revocation of a domestic violence victim's driver's license or registration for non-payment or lapse of insurance coverage
sponsored.sum: Disallows the suspension or revocation of a domestic violence victim's driver's license or registration for non-payment or lapse of insurance coverage upon a proper showing of current insurance and a court order or attorney affirmation that such individual is in fact a victim of domestic violence.

sponsored.t: Relates to required accident damage reporting
sponsored.sum: Requires the cost or estimated cost of repairs for any motor vehicle damaged in such accident, or if a motor vehicle involved in such accident incurred no damage then a notation of such fact to be included in accident reports and for such information to be disclosed in reports made by motor vehicle condition reporting agencies.

sponsored.t: Prohibits employers from retaliating against employees for confronting an individual to prevent a theft or the unlawful taking of goods, wares, or merchandise
sponsored.sum: Prohibits employers from retaliating against employees for confronting an individual to prevent a theft or the unlawful taking of goods, wares, or merchandise; does not prohibit employers from training or re-training employees on policies against confrontation of theft.

sponsored.t: Relates to the classification of the drug xylazine as a controlled substance, and to the criminal sale and possession of xylazine or preparations, compounds, mixtures or substances containing xylazine
sponsored.sum: Relates to the classification of the drug xylazine as a schedule I controlled substance, and to the criminal sale and possession of xylazine or preparations, compounds, mixtures or substances containing xylazine.

sponsored.t: Requires the office of renewable energy siting to develop standards and conditions for the siting of certain large scale renewable energy systems
sponsored.sum: Requires the office of renewable energy siting to develop standards and conditions for the siting of certain large scale renewable energy systems; requires approval of municipalities to such siting plans.

sponsored.t: Relates to aggravated harassment in the second degree
sponsored.sum: Expands the types of transit and tolling employees protected from harassment under the penal law.

sponsored.t: Permits school districts and childcare businesses to look at the social media accounts of prospective employees
sponsored.sum: Permits school districts and entities licensed pursuant to section three hundred ninety of the social services law to look at the social media accounts of prospective employees.

sponsored.t: Includes assault of maintenance employees of the triborough bridge and tunnel authority in the definition of assault in the second degree
sponsored.sum: Includes assault of maintenance employees of the triborough bridge and tunnel authority in the definition of assault in the second degree.

sponsored.t: Establishes a climate action cost council; limits the number of rules and regulations that may be promulgated annually regarding certain climate goals
sponsored.sum: Establishes a climate action cost council; limits the number of rules and regulations that may be promulgated annually to meet CLCPA goals.

sponsored.t: Relates to real property subject to an authorization for a real property tax exemption
sponsored.sum: Relates to real property subject to an authorization for a real property tax exemption in the town of Smithtown, county of Suffolk, with respect to the 2019 and 2020 assessment rolls.

sponsored.t: Relates to decisions regarding the siting of major utility transmission facilities
sponsored.sum: Establishes when making a decision regarding the siting of major utility transmission facilities in the case of a gas transmission line the public service commission must determine whether the alternative method of using commercial vehicles for the purpose of transporting liquified natural gas poses a hazard to public safety.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the Centerport Fire District to file an application for exemption from school taxes and real property taxes
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the Centerport Fire District to file an application for exemption from school taxes and real property taxes.
sponsored.fis: None This act shall take effect immediately. completed on or before such effective date.

sponsored.t: Relates to designating uniformed officers of the fire marshal's office of the town of Huntington as peace officers
sponsored.sum: Designates uniformed officers of the fire marshal's office of the town of Huntington as peace officers.

sponsored.t: Enacts the utility transparency and fair billing protection act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the utility transparency and fair billing protection act to prevent consumers from being overcharged due to misclassified utility rates by mandating proactive account reviews, automatic adjustments, and ensuring clear communication between utilities and customers.

sponsored.t: Relates to returning the state's energy codes to earlier provisions; repealer
sponsored.sum: Returns the state's energy codes to the less expensive earlier provisions; repeals provisions of the state energy conservation construction code which relate to the state's clean energy and climate agenda.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain real property to be conveyed to the town of Huntington
sponsored.sum: Extends provisions relating to certain real property to be conveyed to the town of Huntington for one year.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the county of Suffolk to alienate certain lands used as parklands and to dedicate certain other lands as parklands
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the county of Suffolk to alienate certain lands used as parklands and to dedicate certain other lands as parklands.

sponsored.t: Relates to the Hauppauge Volunteer Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association
sponsored.sum: Amends the name of the Hauppauge Volunteer Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association, and certain provisions regarding removing gendered terminology; relates to the use of foreign fire insurance premium taxes.
